findings.issue: AC13 Given dropped the names of the 7 derived fields and calls the suite 'this service', so the criterion no longer says what is tested.
AC4 Givens became vague ('11 P1 rows', 'ACE read interface') and lost the exposed field name that step 6 states.
AC1 reads the personal count from sys_fields.is_personal with no contract named, which can imply a schema read that AC15 and BR12 forbid.
AC16 and TC-16 compare the live P3 schema, but AC15 gives the suite no client for a service schema. Compare migration file hashes instead.
The SIT-only refusal that TC-17 assigns to AC17 was placed in AC18, the failed-call criterion.
'Done when' says 17 test cases, but there are 18. The note under section 16 also leaves out TC-ITG-E1064-ITG-18.
Section 14 still says all six texts are copied unchanged from RWB-E1-064, although MSG-P1-021 now comes from the Message Standard v4.
